mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 200, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, which together depress corporate earnings growth expectations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE rising and HOUST falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over the last 3 years, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, elevated consumer spending (RSAFS) above 370,000 million dollars signals excessive demand, which accelerates inflation and prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 370000, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals reduced consumer confidence and weak demand for durable goods, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, sustained consumer spending (RSAFS) above 370,000 million dollars signals strong demand, which accelerates growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansions, SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 370000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
